record.content: The live ReserveAmerica facility page identifies EB/110004 as Anthony Chabot, shows the 2026 season open through December 31, and publishes family-site limits of eight people, two vehicles, three dogs, two family sites per party/date, 15 consecutive and 30 annual nights, plus the 0.2-mile walk from parking to hike-in sites 13-22. It states that published inventory is a facility offering, not confirmation of live availability.
